O editor lê as cópias de personagem que: The editor reads the character copies the guardian keeps on the server. Edit a copy and kick the player, and the guardian swaps their save for your version on the next join.
The guardian is in apply mode.
O guardião está em modo observar: ele re: The guardian is in observe mode: it logs the mismatches but does not swap any save.
O guardião guarda o último save que o se: The guardian keeps the last save the server sent to each player. Edit the copy here and kick the player: they come back with your version.
O jogo guarda os 10 últimos salvamentos: The game keeps the last 10 saves automatically; the editor also copies the save before every write.
Para desfazer no servidor, grave de novo: To undo on the server, write back the copy kept in Documents\Enshrouded-Backups\servidor
Pontos em uso ({usados}) passam do total: Points in use ({usados}) exceed the character total ({total})
Remover um material de nível alto fecha: Removing a high-level material closes the recipes that depend on it. Recipes are not stored in the save: the game recomputes them from the knowledge, both here and in the server world.
